purpose: Post-fit CPU audit; cached train/development only; no GPU, new QA, training or heldout readout

definitions.correctness: Original option content correctness summed over two correlated option permutations
definitions.regret: Per-query maximum cached probability gain minus gain of selected subset
definitions.pairwise: Unordered legal candidate pairs; truth gaps <= 1e-4 excluded; predicted ties count incorrect
definitions.gain_loss: Per-question net change over two permutations, not per-permutation transition counts
definitions.blind: History descriptor alone zeroed; question, recent, metadata and bank structure retained
definitions.time_overlap: Only question-visible STAR interval; no hidden interval supplied to the learner

limitations: All data here are development or training; checkpoints use development regret and are not unbiased test results.
More clipping under rank than Huber is recorded; this objective comparison is not a loss-scale ablation.
Both datasets keep original source weighting; no-history rows have zero training loss but remain in the denominator.
An identical policy to LS cannot establish learned content-selection gain or reduced runtime.
